summary: 11 countries. No single American story owns the day. Foreign editors spread their attention across the $40 trillion debt milestone, a Chinese hacking network broken up by US agencies, courts pushing back on tariffs and visa bans, the Iran sanctions campaign, Syria's removal from the terrorism list, and a World Cup exit. Mexico leads on football, France leads on Dolly Parton and the Fed, and Kenya looks at the fine print of US health money.
